svg.aria-label: Stroke, Appearance and Graphic Styles panels
svg.title: Stroke, Appearance and Graphic Styles panels
svg.text: Align: where the stroke sits (not connected yet). Profile: uniform, taper or bulge width
Graphic Styles: click to apply, + saves the selected look
Appearance list, bottom to top: click a row to edit it; eye hides it; drag to reorder with the arrows
Opacity and blend mode of the row (or of the whole object on the last row)
Options of the chosen effect (shadow, glow, blur, round corners, offset, roughen)
Add stroke, add fill, add effect (fx menu), show / hide, move up / down, clear, duplicate, delete
